observations: Photo shows a blue industrial gearbox with a shaft on one side and mounting feet/flange on the body.
A label/sticker is visible on the gearbox body, but the key specs (ratio/model/HP) are not readable in the provided image.
No electric motor is visible in the photo (only the gearbox).
No clear brand/model name is readable from the photo; watermark text is present but not usable as product identity.

claims.claim: Industrial gear box and electric motor 20hp ratio 1:10
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only a gearbox; no motor is shown, and the ratio/20hp are not readable.

risks.risk: Motor not included or not the stated 20hp (photo shows only gearbox).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the motor nameplate (brand, model, HP/kW, voltage/Hz, RPM) and a photo showing both motor + gearbox together.
risks.if_unproven: Price as gearbox only, and treat as not confirmed for 1:10 ratio / not confirmed motor specs.

risks.risk: Gear ratio (1:10) may be different or unknown.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the gearbox nameplate showing the gear ratio and model/serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used industrial gearbox with unknown ratio.

risks.risk: Condition/working status (leaks, worn bearings, shaft play) cannot be confirmed from a single exterior photo.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the gearbox running under load (or at least running freely) plus a photo of any oil level/condition and seals.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case: assume it may need service (as-is, not guaranteed working).

risks.risk: Compatibility risk (input/output shaft size, mounting pattern, rotation direction).
risks.proof: Ask for measurements: input/output shaft diameter, keyway size, bolt pattern, and direction/rotation; plus a photo of both ends with a ruler/caliper.
risks.if_unproven: Price as hard-to-match used gearbox (worst-case compatibility).

proof_requests: Send close-up photos of the gearbox nameplate showing ratio (1:10), model, and serial number.
Send clear photos of the electric motor nameplate (HP/kW, voltage, RPM, model) and confirm it is included.
Send a short running video (gearbox + motor if applicable) showing smooth operation and no abnormal noise.
Provide measurements of shaft diameters/keyway and mounting bolt pattern (with ruler/caliper) for compatibility.
response.reason: The photo only shows a gearbox and does not provide readable proof of the stated 1:10 ratio or the included 20hp motor, so a worst-case price cannot be reliably matched to the comparables.
